newsitem.title: UK: Mitsubishi Trust to buy back two convertible bonds.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Trust to buy back two convertible bonds.

text.p: Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp said in a statement on Friday it was offering to buy back two of its outstanding convertible dollar bond issues.

One convertible bond, issued on August 7, 1987 for $100 million, with a 1.75 percent coupon and due 2002 has $31 million outstanding. The second convertible bond issued on August 5, 1988 with a 3.25 percent coupon and maturing in 2003 has $66.5 million outstanding.
The buyback will end on July 28. The repurchase will be made at a tender price linked to the dollar/yen exchange rate.
The offer is intended to improve the bank's balance sheet efficiency, strengthen its financial position and reduce the potential number of common stock, the statement said.
